do
  hush
  setcps (122/60/4)
  let swing = nudge (fast 8 "0 0.02")
  d1 $ swing $ s "bd*4" # gain 0.9 # lpf 800
  d2 $ swing $ every 2 (fast 2) $ struct "t(3,8)" $ s "hh" # gain 0.5 # room 0.1
  d3 $ swing $ s "~ [cp ~] ~ cp" # gain 0.6 # room 0.15
  d4 $ swing $ slow 2 $ note (scale "minor" "<0 [-3 0] -5 [-7 -5] -3 [0 2] 4 [2 0]>") # s "flbass" # legato 1 # gain 0.9 # lpf 500
  d5 $ slow 8 $ note (scale "minor" "<[0,3,7,10] [-3,0,4,7] [-5,-2,2,5] [-7,-4,0,3]>") # s "jrhodes" # room 0.7 # gain 0.65
  d6 $ swing $ sometimesBy 0.4 (# nudge 0.02) $ s "hh*2" # nudge "<0 0.25 0.25 0.25>" # gain 0.4

  -- d2 silence
